description.en: sandbox execution, injection defense, and permission guardrails for production agents
description.zh: 生产级 Agent 的沙盒执行、注入防御和权限护栏

goal.en: Secure your agents before they go to production

outcome.en: Configure sandbox boundaries, detect indirect prompt injections, enforce permission allow/deny lists, and add human-in-the-loop approval for sensitive operations — so your agents are safe to run in production.
outcome.zh: 配置沙盒边界、检测间接提示注入、强制权限白名单/黑名单、为敏感操作添加人工审批——让你的 Agent 安全地跑在生产环境中。

reason.en: The core security layer: sandbox configuration, injection detection, permission boundaries, and audit logging — everything your agent needs before it touches production.
reason.zh: 核心安全层：沙盒配置、注入检测、权限边界和审计日志——Agent 接触生产环境前需要的所有保障。

en: Set up permission boundaries for my agent
Block my agent from running sudo or rm -rf
Scan this URL for indirect prompt injection
zh: 为我的 Agent 设置权限边界
禁止 Agent 执行 sudo 或 rm -rf
扫描这个 URL 是否存在间接提示注入

reason.en: Build MCP servers with proper auth and scope — ensure your agent's integrations don't expose more than intended.
reason.zh: 构建带认证和作用域的 MCP Server——确保 Agent 集成不会暴露超出预期的能力。

en: Build an MCP server with scoped read-only access
Add authentication to my existing MCP server
Audit my MCP server for excessive permissions
zh: 构建带作用域只读访问的 MCP Server
为我现有的 MCP Server 添加认证
审查我的 MCP Server 是否权限过大

reason.en: Delegate security test generation and vulnerability scanning to a coding agent — automate your security QA.
reason.zh: 把安全测试生成和漏洞扫描委托给 coding agent——自动化你的安全 QA。

en: Delegate security test generation to Claude Code
Have Codex scan this codebase for injection vulnerabilities
Run OWASP compliance checks in a background agent
zh: 让 Claude Code 生成安全测试
让 Codex 扫描代码库的注入漏洞
在后台 agent 中运行 OWASP 合规检查
